scope: Free official documents that contain explicit vehicle dimensions. Each entry links directly to the dimension-bearing document or page.

sources.name: Tesla 2017-2023 Model 3 Dimensional Specifications
sources.dimension_content: Under-body, side-body, under-hood, and rear-body point-to-point dimensions. Values are in millimetres. Holes, slots, marks, and fasteners are measured centre-to-centre. The stated general tolerance is +/- 3 mm.
sources.limitations: These are structural body reference dimensions. They do not define every removable trim or service part. Tesla marks the measurements as reference only.

sources.name: Tesla 2024 Model 3 Dimensional Specifications
sources.dimension_content: Under-body, side-body, under-hood, rear-body, top, and A-pillar point-to-point dimensions in millimetres.
sources.limitations: These are structural body reference dimensions. They do not define every removable trim or service part.

sources.name: Tesla 2021+ Model X Dimensional Specifications
sources.dimension_content: Under-body, side-body, under-hood, rear-body, top, and A-pillar point-to-point dimensions in millimetres.
sources.limitations: These are structural body reference dimensions. Verify the build configuration before use.

sources.name: Tesla 2020-2024 Model Y Dimensional Specifications
sources.dimension_content: Structural point-to-point body dimensions in millimetres, with measured vehicle reference points shown in the figures.
sources.limitations: Check the structural pack configuration before applying a value.

sources.dimension_content: Structural point-to-point body dimensions in millimetres, with measured vehicle reference points shown in the figures.

sources.name: Tesla 2021+ Model S Dimensional Specifications
sources.dimension_content: Structural point-to-point body dimensions in millimetres, with measured vehicle reference points shown in the figures.

sources.name: Tesla 2025+ Model Y L Dimensional Specifications
sources.dimension_content: Under-body, side-body, under-hood, rear-body, top, and A-pillar point-to-point dimensions in millimetres.
sources.limitations: This document is for Model Y L. Do not apply it to another Model Y body configuration.

sources.name: GM 2015-2018 Chevrolet City Express Cargo Van Body Builder Manual
sources.dimension_content: Seat mounting-hole positions, body openings, cargo area, and other body dimensions in millimetres and inches. The front seat mounting-hole drawing states A=380 mm, B=375 mm, C=560 mm, and D=550 mm.
sources.document_location: Body Dimensions, including page 59 for Front Seat Mounting Hole Dimensions
sources.limitations: The manual applies only to the stated model years and body configuration. It is not a general Chevrolet parts drawing.

sources.name: Stellantis 2017 Ram 1500 SSV Upfitter Guide
sources.dimension_content: Body dimensions in metric and English units. Table 2 includes bumper, cab, box, tank, and seating reference dimensions.
sources.limitations: The guide applies to the stated special-service vehicle configuration. It does not define every service part.
